meta.name: quantizing-models-bitsandbytes
meta.description: Quantizes LLMs to 8-bit or 4-bit for 50-75% memory reduction with minimal accuracy loss. Use when GPU memory is limited, need to fit larger models, or want faster inference. Supports INT8, NF4, FP4 formats, QLoRA training, and 8-bit optimizers. Works with HuggingFace Transformers.

copy.tagline: 将大模型量化到8位或4位，节省50-75%显存
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果GPU显存有限，需要运行更大模型或加速推理
copy.tagline_en: Quantize LLMs to 8-bit or 4-bit, reducing memory by 50-75%
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have limited GPU memory and need to run larger models or speed up inference

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你把大型语言模型压缩到8位或4位，显存占用减少50%到75%，同时保持高精度。它支持INT8、NF4、FP4等格式，还能配合QLoRA进行微调，或使用8位优化器节省训练内存。
howto.when: 当你需要加载大模型但GPU显存不足，或者想加快推理速度时触发。也适用于使用HuggingFace Transformers进行模型微调或训练的场景。

say.text: 帮我用4位量化加载Llama 2 7B模型。

say.note: Claude会配置4位基模型并添加LoRA适配器，开始微调。

say.text: 设置8位优化器来训练模型。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you compress large language models to 8-bit or 4-bit, reducing GPU memory usage by 50-75% with minimal accuracy loss. It supports INT8, NF4, FP4 formats, QLoRA fine-tuning, and 8-bit optimizers for memory-efficient training.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to load large models with limited GPU memory, want faster inference, or are using HuggingFace Transformers for fine-tuning or training.

say_en.text: Set up an 8-bit optimizer for training.
say_en.note: Claude uses 8-bit AdamW optimizer, reducing optimizer memory by 75%.
